findings.title: Keep the verified first-action census; narrow the discrimination interpretation

locations.exact_passage: The table does show discrimination at the first menu.
An agent that quits has judged the whole route from the first menu.

evidence.source: reviews/sol/saved_record_checks.json and cited frozen source passages
evidence.detail: Original first decisions reproduce 50/56 above-bound declarations and 3/131 payable declarations. Eight of the fifty above-bound menus offer neither sale nor mortgage; the other forty-two offer a financing action. Six above-bound episodes continue before elimination. None of the fifty is a fallback. These actions do not measure calibrated beliefs or make continuing an error.

findings.recommendation: Retain counts beside the full debt partition and describe applied first actions. Disclose the eight no-financing menus. Remove the claim that every declaration establishes assessment of the whole route or a classification accuracy score.

findings.title: Two-stage resampling changes the fixed-rotation design

locations.exact_passage: Our primary summary therefore resamples seed blocks and then games within each drawn block (20,000 draws)

evidence.source: reviews/sol/saved_record_checks.json and cited frozen source passages
evidence.detail: Each original seed block contains each of four cyclic rotations once. Sampling its four games with replacement can duplicate one rotation and omit another. Exact intact-block resampling reproduces the 24.2 to 35.5 point range, while the two-stage calculation adds a separate reweighting of rotation cells.

findings.recommendation: Prefer intact blocks for the fixed-rotation composition diagnostic. If retaining two-stage results, label the additional assumption and target; do not claim that they preserve the same four-rotation design or have future-seed coverage.
findings.status: integration correction proposed; frozen inputs untouched

findings.title: Arithmetic sufficiency does not establish alternative executable routes

locations.exact_passage: In the other five, four by Gemini in G3 and one by Sol in G18, the agents could have paid from listed mortgages and salvage alone.
In the other five the released deeds were one way to pay among several.

evidence.source: reviews/sol/saved_record_checks.json and cited frozen source passages
evidence.detail: The 19/14/5 and 33-action counts reproduce. The five optional rows have C+M0+S at or above debt. That upper bound does not by itself establish a legal route excluding new mortgages under sale ordering and house-stock constraints; no such alternative route was run here. Actual payment establishes the observed route.

findings.recommendation: Say five used released collateral despite arithmetic sufficiency of listed mortgages plus salvage. Do not assert several legal alternatives without a retained witness.

findings.title: Specify the direct dice event in the G13 probability correction

evidence.source: reviews/sol/saved_record_checks.json and cited frozen source passages
evidence.detail: Atlantic to Short Line is a direct move of nine. Four of thirty-six equally likely two-dice outcomes total nine. Other movement and extra rolls are different events. The surrounding Astra caveat addresses doubles but leaves the first probability sentence less specific than Sol/Opus.

findings.recommendation: Use: A direct dice move from Atlantic to Short Line requires nine, with probability 4/36. This does not quantify every way to arrive during a turn.
